attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indo-MIM Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, received from CARE Ratings Limited on November 13, 2026. The report covers the utilization of Rs. 500 crore raised through the Initial Public Offer. No deviation from the objects was reported. Rs. 400 crore was fully utilized for repayment of outstanding borrowings. Rs. 75.90 crore was utilized for general corporate purposes, including customs duty payments of Rs. 2.90 crore, advance tax payments of Rs. 20.00 crore, and vendor payments of Rs. 53.00 crore. Rs. 14.56 crore remains unutilized for issue expenses. The total unutilized amount stands at Rs. 24.10 crore. The company routed funds through current accounts, resulting in comingling of funds. CARE Ratings relied on supporting bank statements and email confirmations for verification.

attchmntText: INDO-MIM Limited has informed the Exchange about the Proposal to make investment in Meena Solar Power Park Private Limited to acquire 6.5% equity stake under group captive scheme.
voiceSummary: INDO-MIM Limited approved its Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved an investment proposal to subscribe to equity shares of M/s. Meena Solar Power Park Private Limited. The investment amount will not exceed Rs. 97,500, representing 6.5% of the Target Company's share capital. The Company will enter into a Power Purchase Agreement and a Share Purchase Agreement to purchase electricity under the Group Captive Scheme. The Company will update the Stock Exchange upon execution of these agreements. The Board meeting commenced at 07:00 P.M. and concluded at 08:00 P.M. on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Intimation of an earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
voiceSummary: INDO-MIM Limited will hold an earnings conference call on Monday, 16th November, 2026, at 15:00 HRS IST to discuss results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The call will feature Mr. Krishna Chivukula Jr., Chief Executive Officer, and Mr. Parasuraman Balasubramanian, CFO. Discussions will rely on publicly available information, with no unpublished price sensitive information shared. Dial-in numbers include Universal Access +91 22 6280 1458 and International Toll Free lines for Hong Kong, Singapore, UK, and USA. Details are available on the company website at www.indo-mim.com. The schedule may be revised due to unforeseen circumstances. HDFC Securities Limited is facilitating the call.
